title: 第一卷 第3章 贬为奴仆第一卷 第4章 暴怒出手
content_zh:
“嗯？宣判？”
叶寒冷漠地看着包围上来的一众叶家侍卫。
“叶寒，听说你境界已废，没想到你也有今天。”
叶鸣戏谑开口，得意洋洋地打量叶寒。
刹那间，数名侍卫左右扣住叶寒的胳膊，在叶鸣的示意下走出院外。
“你们要将我带去何处？”
叶寒脸色平静。
“叶寒，炎城各位大人已经到了，包括炎阳书院也有人到来，今日是我叶家天之骄女出世，全城见证，也是你这野种世子落幕之时。”
叶鸣面容阴翳：“家主大人宣判废掉你世子身份后，就留在我身边做一条狗吧。”
“对了，你那残废老师也要来，师徒两个都是废物，正好凑一对。
说起你那老师，虽然是个残废，可不得不说身材样貌倒真是饱满诱人，炎城没人比得上，若真有机会收入身下，想象她婉转承欢……。”
叶鸣满脸垂涎。
“不知死活！”
叶寒猛然驻足，力贯四周，凶猛的劲气猛然激荡，一群侍卫被轰然而倒。
“你……你怎么？”
叶鸣勃然色变，一道可怖的拳头映入眼帘。
轰……！
拳力爆开！
咔嚓一声裂响，叶鸣被轰出五米开外，胸骨碎裂，身躯抽搐呻吟，再也爬不起来。
叶鸣不过是聚元五重的武者，年龄的缘故，连炎阳书院都进不去，承受这一拳就算是救治过来，以后也是废了。

“辱我老师，找死？”
叶寒扫了那尸体一眼，转身看向几名叶家侍卫：“他们聚在何处？”
“广……广场，家族广场！”
一群人慌不择言，恐惧至极。
未曾理会这几个小侍卫，叶寒直接走向叶家广场，寒气摄人。
一日不见，如逝三年，他已经不是昨天那个叶寒。
什么君子报仇十年不晚，都是屁话，叶芷萱，今天就要死。
本想回到书院再准备对付叶家的事宜，但现在看来，有些事情是等不了了。
听到叶鸣说城内各种所谓的大人物到来，老师也会现身，叶寒无所顾忌，再也无法隐忍。
叶家广场。
诸多身影已经就座，诸多叶家族人、侍卫都是目光兴奋，满脸期待地现身广场四周。
叶家家主叶阳甫为首，身侧站着叶芷萱，在叶芷萱身边还陪同着一名身着白衫，剑眉星目，年约二十上下的男子。
这男子气势非凡，不知何等身份，昔日还真未曾见过。
此外便是城主府的大管家李悬，炎城内赵家、王家、朱家的家主，以及炎阳书院的数位老师等人。
可以说整个炎城的大人物几乎全部到来。
“连城主府的人都来了？来得好……。”
叶寒心中冷笑，扫了一眼那叶芷萱父女两人，随后径直走向人群一处。
看到叶寒孤身坦然到来，叶家家主叶阳甫轻微皱眉，不过看了一眼身边的女儿，倒是再度恢复正常。
“老师！”
content_en:
"Huh? Sentence?"
Ye Han looked indifferently at the group of Ye family guards who surrounded him.
"Ye Han, I heard that your realm has been destroyed. I didn't expect that you would be here today."
Ye Ming joked and looked at Ye Han proudly.
In an instant, several guards grabbed Ye Han's arms and walked out of the hospital at Ye Ming's signal.
"Where are you taking me?"
Ye Han's face was calm.
"Ye Han, all the adults in Yancheng have arrived, including people from Yanyang Academy. Today is the birth of the proud daughter of my Ye family, and the whole city will witness it. It is also the end of this bastard son like you."
Ye Ming's face was gloomy: "After the master of the family declares that you are deprived of your identity as the heir apparent, just stay with me and be a dog."
"By the way, your disabled teacher is coming too. Both master and apprentice are useless, so they make a perfect couple.
Speaking of your teacher, although she is a disabled person, I have to say that her figure is really plump and attractive. No one in Yancheng can compare with her. If there is a chance to be with you, imagine her being gentle and charming... "
Ye Ming's face was filled with salivation.
"I don't know whether to live or die!"
Ye Han suddenly stopped and thrust his force into the surroundings. The ferocious energy suddenly aroused, and a group of guards were knocked down.
"You...what are you doing?"
Ye Ming's expression suddenly changed, and a terrifying fist came into view.
boom……!
The punch explodes!
There was a cracking sound, and Ye Ming was blasted five meters away. His sternum was shattered, his body twitched and groaned, and he could no longer get up.
Ye Ming is only a fifth-level martial artist of Juyuan. Due to his age, he cannot even enter Yanyang Academy. Even if he is cured after receiving this punch, he will be disabled in the future.
"Insult my teacher and seek death?"
Ye Han glanced at the corpse, then turned to look at several Ye family guards: "Where are they gathering?"
"Guang... square, family square!"
A group of people panicked and were extremely frightened.
Ignoring these little guards, Ye Han walked directly to the Yejia Square, feeling the chilly air.
Not seeing him for one day is like three years gone. He is no longer the same Ye Han as yesterday.
It's all bullshit that a gentleman says it's never too late to take revenge after ten years. Ye Zhixuan is going to die today.
I originally wanted to go back to the academy and prepare to deal with the Ye family, but now it seems that some things can't wait.
Hearing Ye Ming say that various so-called big shots in the city are coming, and the teacher will also show up, Ye Han has no scruples and can no longer bear it.
Yejia Square.
Many figures were already seated, and many Ye family members and guards appeared around the square with excited eyes and expectant faces.
The head of the Ye family, Ye Yangfu, was headed by Ye Zhixuan. Next to Ye Zhixuan was a man in his twenties, wearing a white shirt, with sharp eyebrows and starry eyes.
This man has an extraordinary aura. I don’t know his identity. I have never seen him before.
In addition, there are Li Xuan, the chief steward of the City Lord's Mansion, the heads of the Zhao family, Wang family, and Zhu family in Yancheng, as well as several teachers from Yanyang Academy and others.
It can be said that almost all the big shots in Yancheng have arrived.
"Even people from the City Lord's Mansion are here? It's a good thing..."
Ye Han sneered in his heart, glanced at Ye Zhixuan and his daughter, and then walked straight towards the crowd.
Seeing Ye Han arriving alone and calmly, Ye Yangfu, the head of the Ye family, frowned slightly, but after taking a look at his daughter beside him, he returned to normal.
"teacher!"
